## Academic Focus

SECR is the final stage of a project I am helping with from collected Gibbon spectograms, occurring after data processing, machine learning with CNNs and a shiny app. 

This website will help you with the R package, SECR (spatially explicit capture-recapture), used in estimating animal abundances.
